notes.title: White Bean Chili — recipe
notes.content: Serves 6. Two cans cannellini beans, one yellow onion, two poblanos, a quart of veggie stock. Saute the onion and poblanos, add beans and stock, simmer 25 minutes, and double the smoked paprika — trust me. Finish with lime and crushed tortilla chips. Freezes well in quart jars.
